What we bend

Practical Metal Bending for Fabrication Jobs

Bar bending is usually not a standalone decorative process. Buyers come to us when a part has to fit a real assembly, match a drawing, or repeat across a production batch. We help check whether the bend is practical for the material, section size, bend length and required angle before quoting.

Bar and Angle Bending

Useful for support brackets, industrial frames, machine guards, stiffeners, panel structures, stand parts and custom fabricated assemblies. We work with mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium sections where the bend angle and repeatability matter.

Plate and Profile Bending

Many parts need laser cutting or CNC punching first, followed by bending. S.B.G. Punching can coordinate cutting, punching and bending under one workflow so the blank size, hole position and bend line are planned together.

Production Job Work

We support single-piece trials, small batches and repeat production. Fabrication shops and OEM vendors use us when they need local bending capacity, quick sample checking and clear communication on dimensions.

Common questions

Before You Send a Bar Bending Enquiry

Can you bend without a CAD drawing?

Yes, for simple jobs a clear sketch, sample photo and dimensions can be enough to begin. For repeat production, a drawing helps avoid confusion on angle, radius, length and hole positions.

Can cutting and bending be done together?

Yes. Many brackets, plates and profiles need laser cutting or CNC punching before bending. Sharing the final use helps us plan blank size, bend direction and sequence.

Do you accept small quantities?

We can review single-piece trials, small batches and repeat orders. Price and turnaround depend on material, setup time, bend complexity and quantity.
